description: 24 synthetic UI examples authored for a local exploratory experiment; no production strings, human-reviewed translation references, or prevalence claim. Checks are narrow predeclared requirement probes, not complete linguistic quality judgments. French/German lexical probes allow common intended-sense forms but require manual adjudication of alternative valid wording. Hindi/Bengali terminal ASCII-period checks express an experiment-specific locale policy supplied only in the locale-suffix arm; they measure adherence to that supplied policy, not inherent correctness of a language's punctuation.

localeSuffixes.hi: For this product's Hindi UI style, end every complete declarative or imperative sentence with the ASCII period (.) rather than the danda (।). Preserve protected placeholders, code, filenames, and approved glossary spellings.
localeSuffixes.bn: For this product's Bengali UI style, end every complete declarative or imperative sentence with the ASCII period (.) rather than the danda (।). Preserve protected placeholders, code, filenames, and approved glossary spellings.
